name: unknowns
description: Know your unknowns — skills for the gap between your plan and reality, in any domain: what you don't know, what the AI doesn't, and what neither knows yet. Eleven skills: blind-spot passes, field primers, interviews, divergent prototypes, brainstorming, reference read-backs, tweakable plans, a deviation log, buy-in docs, quizzes and the unknowns loop — plus two Claude Code agents. Each runs only when you say unknowns or its name. From Thariq Shihipar's (Anthropic) 'Field Guide to Fable' talk.
